counted_unit_requires: a distinct falsifiable hypothesis owned by exactly one unit
an executable component, reproduction, test, adversarial case or acceptance decision
an artifact manifest with SHA-256 hashes and exact byte counts
a durable commit read back by a different process from an immutable object id
a terminal durable disposition and an immutable locator
counted_unit_excludes: provider completion without a durable result commit

state_at_this_revision.note: Completion here means the coordinator verified a durable result and read every artifact back by immutable object id. It is not acceptance. Independent disposition by a non-producer remains outstanding and is NOT_YET.

preconditions_required: Wave A demonstrates zero false completion
Wave A demonstrates zero result loss
Wave A demonstrates zero path collision

precondition_status.zero_false_completion: PASS at this revision, 0 observed across 65 tracked units
precondition_status.zero_result_loss: NOT_YET, 31 of 64 units are still executing
precondition_status.zero_path_collision_basis: A cross-controller collision was observed on po03-canary-001 and repaired with atomic remote-ref ownership. The repaired mechanism holds for all 64 Wave A slots with 0 contention, but the precondition must be re-demonstrated against a completed Wave A before Wave B may open.

wave_b.opening_authority: PO-03 may open Wave B on its own evidence once all three preconditions read PASS; it may not open it on partial evidence

concurrency.honest_limitation: No provider ceiling can be reported as a number because no refusal, throttle or queueing occurred at the concurrency driven. This is an observed lower bound on capacity, not a measured maximum.

isolation_mechanism.per_subordinate: dedicated git worktree plus a dedicated result branch
isolation_mechanism.per_unit: one disjoint owned subtree under workstreams/po03/attempts/<task_id>/
isolation_mechanism.identifier_namespacing: every identifier carries the controller run suffix b2e7 so a concurrent sibling controller cannot contend

reduction_justification: The full commissioned breadth was created, claimed and dispatched; no unit was dropped, merged or renamed to reduce the count.
